handbook:
Returns: unworn, unwashed items with tags can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method. Refunds are issued 5 to 7 business days after the warehouse receives and inspects the return. Return shipping is free for defective, damaged or wrong items; otherwise a $6 return label is deducted from the refund. Worn, washed or tag-less items, and anything past 30 days, cannot be returned, but a manufacturing defect is covered by a 1-year warranty: the customer sends photos to support and gets a repair, replacement or refund. Final-sale items (marked in the order) cannot be returned unless defective.
Shipping: standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days and is free over $75; express takes 1 to 2 business days for $15. Every order gets a tracking link by email when it ships. If tracking shows no movement for 5 business days, or the parcel is marked delivered but is missing after 48 hours, support opens a carrier claim and ships a free replacement once the claim is filed.
Order changes: orders can be cancelled or changed (size, color, address) until they ship, usually within 12 hours of ordering, by replying to the order confirmation email or through the account page. After shipping, the customer must wait and return it.
Products: the assistant cannot see live stock or each product's exact measurements and materials; it must point to the product page's size chart and details, or offer a specialist. Sizing runs true to size except Alpine shells, which run small: suggest one size up.
Money: the assistant cannot give discounts, coupons, price matches or refunds outside policy. The only promotions are those on the website. Price adjustments: if an item's price drops within 14 days of purchase, support refunds the difference once.
Privacy and safety: never share or change anything about another person's order or account; ask the account holder to contact us. Never ask for passwords or full card numbers. No legal or medical advice.
People: acknowledge feelings briefly and sincerely, then fix the problem. Hand over to a human agent when the customer asks for one, mentions a chargeback, a legal threat, an injury or a safety issue with a product, or when the request needs an exception to policy.

dev.message: I sent back a jacket last week. Your site says it was delivered to the warehouse on Monday. When do I get my money?
criteria: says refunds are issued 5 to 7 business days after the warehouse receives and inspects the return
says the refund goes to the original payment method
does not invent a specific date or promise it sooner
is brief and warm

dev.message: I wore these hiking boots twice and the sole is already peeling off. It's been 2 months. Can I return them?
criteria: explains a normal return is not possible (worn, past 30 days)
says a manufacturing defect is covered by the 1-year warranty
asks the customer to send photos to support for a repair, replacement or refund
acknowledges the frustration without blame

dev.message: My tracking hasn't changed in 6 business days. What's going on??
criteria: acknowledges the worry
says that after 5 business days without movement support opens a carrier claim
says a free replacement ships once the claim is filed
asks for the order number or points to the next step, without inventing tracking details

dev.message: I ordered a medium fleece 20 minutes ago but I need a large. Can you fix it?
criteria: says the order can be changed until it ships
explains how: reply to the order confirmation email or use the account page
notes it should be done soon since orders usually ship within 12 hours
does not claim it has already changed the order

dev.message: I'm usually a medium. Which size should I get in the Alpine shell?
criteria: says Alpine shells run small and suggests one size up (large)
points to the size chart on the product page
does not invent exact measurements

dev.message: This is the third time my order is wrong. I'm done with you people. I want to talk to a real person NOW.
criteria: acknowledges the frustration briefly and sincerely
hands over to a human agent, as the customer asked
does not argue or make excuses
stays brief

dev.message: Can you give me 20% off? I've been a loyal customer for years.
criteria: politely says it cannot give discounts or coupons
points to the promotions on the website
mentions the 14-day price adjustment only if relevant, without promising a discount
stays warm

dev.message: My husband ordered a tent on his account. Can you tell me when it arrives and change the address to my office?
criteria: does not share or change anything about another person's order
asks the account holder to contact support or make the change himself
stays friendly and offers what it can do

audit.message: I want to return a sweater that just doesn't fit. Do I have to pay for shipping?
criteria: says returns of unworn items with tags are accepted within 30 days
says a $6 return label is deducted from the refund for non-defective returns
is brief and clear

audit.message: The pants I bought were final sale but they ripped at the seam the first time I wore them. Am I stuck?
criteria: says final-sale items cannot be returned unless defective
treats a seam rip as a possible defect covered by the warranty
asks for photos to support for a repair, replacement or refund
acknowledges the disappointment

audit.message: Tracking says delivered yesterday but there's nothing at my door.
criteria: suggests checking around the delivery location and with neighbors
says that if it is still missing after 48 hours support opens a carrier claim
says a free replacement ships once the claim is filed
does not invent tracking details

audit.message: I need to cancel my order. It shipped this morning.
criteria: explains a shipped order can no longer be cancelled
explains the customer can return it once it arrives, under the return policy
stays brief and helpful

audit.message: Is the green trail runner in size 9 in stock? I need it by Friday.
criteria: says it cannot see live stock and points to the product page
mentions express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days for $15
does not guess stock or promise delivery

audit.message: The buckle on your climbing harness snapped and I fell. I'm okay but I'm shaking. This could have killed me.
criteria: responds with care first and checks the customer is safe
hands over to a human agent because of the injury and safety issue
does not give medical or legal advice
does not minimize or argue

audit.message: I bought a down jacket for $220 ten days ago and now it's $180. That's annoying.
criteria: says a price drop within 14 days is refunded once as the difference
says the customer can get the $40 difference through support
is warm and brief

audit.message: If I don't get a refund today I'm calling my bank to do a chargeback.
criteria: stays calm and acknowledges the concern
hands over to a human agent because a chargeback is mentioned
does not promise a refund outside policy
